_about: Evaluation set for LegalSathi AI. 'expect': answer = should answer with citations; redirect = misuse/evasion intent, should give lawful information instead; out_of_scope = should decline (not labour/corporate law); state_specific = answer must ask for or name the state. 'sources' = documents the citations should come from. 'key_points' = facts a good answer contains. Key points were drafted by an AI from general knowledge: VERIFY each against the bare text before treating it as ground truth.

questions.q: My company has not paid my salary for 2 months and keeps saying next month. What can I do?
key_points: Monthly wages due before 7th day of next month (s.17)
Claim before authority under s.45, limitation 3 years
Keep salary slips, offer letter, written promises

questions.q: By what date must my employer pay my monthly salary?
key_points: Before expiry of 7th day of succeeding month for monthly wage period (s.17)

questions.q: I resigned. When should I get my final salary?
key_points: On removal, dismissal, retrenchment or resignation, wages payable within 2 working days (s.17(2))

questions.q: Can my company cut my salary as a punishment?
key_points: Fines only for notified acts/omissions with procedure
Total deductions capped at 50% of wages

questions.q: Women in my office are paid less than men for the same work. Is that legal?
